mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 5.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures indicate robust aggregate demand, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 in any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes where industrial production exceeds 110.0 (index 2017=100), rising inflation pressures and impending monetary tightening cause S&P 500 forward returns to turn negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 110.0, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.03 over any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 2.2% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.2, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are rising and industrial production (INDPRO) is stable, it indicates a balanced economy with strong consumer demand and steady supply, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST is rising and INDPRO is stable, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.04 in any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) over the past month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS has increased over the past month, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 in any 12-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes where the federal funds rate is below 2.0%, the S&P 500 tends to experience positive returns due to continued accommodative policy, leading to positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 6-month rolling window.
